title_zh: 先约一次午休短走再考虑装备

scenario.label_zh: 商量改变久坐习惯的第一步
scenario.goal_zh: 约定一次午间短距离散步并澄清不需要先购买设备

context_zh: 朋友想改变久坐的日常习惯，两人约定从一起散步开始。
author: author-phase04-a

sentences.speaker: Omar
sentences.text: My lifestyle has become very inactive since I started working from home.

sentences.speaker: Clare
sentences.text: Would you like to join me for a short walk at lunchtime?

sentences.speaker: Omar
sentences.text: Yes. Do I need a fitness watch or anything like that?

sentences.speaker: Clare
sentences.text: That is not necessary for walking with me. We can just go round the block and see how you like it.

sentences.speaker: Omar
sentences.text: Let us try tomorrow at half past twelve.

sentences.speaker: Clare
sentences.text: Great. I will meet you outside your building.
